# sakura_networking_suite_subnet_group (Resource)

Manages a Networking Suite Subnet Group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sakura_networking_suite_subnet_group" "foobar" {
  name               = "foobar"
  description        = "description"
  ipv4_address_range = "10.0.0.0/20"
  region             = "is1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ipv4_address_range` (String) The IPv4 address range in CIDR format
- `name` (String) The name of the Networking Suite Subnet Group.
- `region` (String) The target region code of the subnet group

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the Networking Suite Subnet Group. The length of this value must be in the range [`1`-`512`]
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `zone` (String) The name of zone that the subnet group will be created (e.g. `is1c`, `tk1a`)

### Read-Only

- `srn` (String) The SRN of the Networking Suite Subnet Group.
